2.help: The official build from Google. Ladilala downloads it, checks it and keeps old versions for roll back. Use it when no browser is installed or a policy blocks the others.

3.title: Ladilala Chromium
3.help: Our own patched build. It is not built yet, so there is nothing to download.

title.1: Press Record, fill the form once.

body.1: Ladilala opens the page in your browser profile. Fill the form once, as you would by hand.
body.2: In the browser page, type a name in double braces, for example {ph}, in any text field. It becomes a data column. A short hint card in the page shows how.
body.3: Each data column is now a column in the template. Fill the file with one row for each run, then Save.
body.4: In the editor, open the Mapping and data tab and link the filled file. Then press Run.
